name: FLSmidth & Co. A/S
summary: FLSmidth & Co. A/S provides flowsheet technology and service solutions for the mining industries in Denmark, the United States of America, Canada, Chile, Brazil, Peru, Australia, North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Asia. The company operates through three segments: Service; Products; and Pumps, Cyclones & Valves (PC&V). The company offers mineral processing equipment, such as hydrocyclones and REFLUX classifiers; cone and roll crushers, crushing stations, gyratory and jaw crushers, and sizers; centrifuges, thickeners and clarifiers, and filters; apron and belt feeders, buffalo and vibrating feeders, mine hoists, hybrid apron feeders, and mine shaft equipment; and at…
